name: Ducati Darmah 900SD
engine: 864 cc air-cooled bevel-drive desmo V-twin, two carbs, electric start
intro: Ducati's bevel-drive sport tourer. Electric start, desmo heads and Bosch electronic ignition.

H: The bevel-drive cams are set with shims and need patience. Check the bevel gear backlash and the valve shims before you run it hard.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
